bio: Yandiola is located inside the Askuna Zentroa civic and cultural centre, where the interior design and meticulous lighting come as a pleasant surprise. The updated take on traditional cuisine on offer here includes the à la carte with headings such as “Yandiola’s classic dishes”, “An Ode to Cod”, “Tradition”, and “The Grill”) plus two tasting menus: Seasonal (available for lunch midweek only) and the eponymous Yandiola....
